# Timer

`Timer` is an object type. You don't create it directly: you get one from another call, then call its methods with a colon, e.g. `timer:name()`.

## Methods

| Function | Description | Since |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [`name()`](name.md) | Get / Set the timer name. | 1.1.0 |
| [`direction()`](direction.md) | Get / Set the timer direction (1 / -1) | 1.1.0 |
| [`persistent()`](persistent.md) | Get / Set the timer persistent attribute. | 26.1.0 |
| [`value()`](value.md) | Get / Set the timer value. | 1.1.0 |
| [`stringValue()`](stringValue.md) | Return the timer value as a string. | 1.5.8 |
| [`alarm()`](alarm.md) | Get / Set the alarm value of the timer. | 1.1.0 |
| [`start()`](start.md) | Get / Set the start value of the timer. | 1.1.0 |
| [`startCondition()`](startCondition.md) | Get / Set the start condition of the timer. | 1.1.0 |
| [`stopCondition()`](stopCondition.md) | Get / Set the stop condition of the timer. | 26.1.0 |
| [`countingSource()`](countingSource.md) | Get / Set the counting source of the timer. | 26.1.0 |
| [`voice()`](voice.md) | Get / Set the voice used by the timer. | 26.1.0 |
| [`audioActions()`](audioActions.md) | Get / Set the audio actions of the timer. | 1.5.0 |
| [`resetCondition()`](resetCondition.md) | Get / Set the reset condition of the timer. | 1.1.0 |
| [`reset()`](reset.md) | Reset the timer. | 1.4.10 |
| [`running()`](running.md) | Return the running state of the timer. | 1.5.0 |
